mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift to monetary easing, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of macro easing episodes, or 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of tightening episodes, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly different from zero (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below 105.0 for 3 consecutive months signals a weakening supply-side momentum, reducing corporate earnings expectations and compressing discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
